# Stage 13 Frontier Ledger

## Exact dependent theorem

After quotienting gauge directions, the curvature is an isotropic Gaussian on
`im(d1) tensor R^3`.  Its ambient covariance is `t P tensor I3`, where `P` is
an orthogonal projection.  Shared-link and Bianchi dependence are therefore
retained, while every restricted covariance is bounded by `t I`.

For `s=rho^2/t>3`, every set `S` of `k` plaquettes obeys

```text
P(||F_p||>=rho for all p in S) <= exp(-k J3(s)),
J3(s)=(s-3-3 log(s/3))/2.
```

No independence hypothesis is used.  This is a rooted connected-event sum,
not yet an identification of Mayer/Ursell activities for a partition-function
expansion.

## Claim boundary

This removes the independence assumption only from the linearized Gaussian
model.  It does not construct a Mayer expansion, bound BCH terms, the link Haar density, continuous
large-field collars, topological sectors, or repeated nonlinear RG.

Strongest level: `C2`.
